# Unlocks reference

The component that buys and keeps unlocks, and the unlock asset with its cost and prerequisites. For how to use it, see [Unlocks](../modules/unlocks.md).

## VtUnitUnlocks

Component. Add it with **Add Component → Vantage → Progression → VtUnitUnlocks**.

What a unit has unlocked, and the way it buys more. Add it to a player to let it research or buy blueprints with `TryUnlock`.

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `IReadOnlyCollection<VtUnlockDefinition> Owned { get; }` | The unlocks this unit keeps for itself. Unlocks kept by its stash are not listed; use `Has` for the combined check. |
| `IVtCostSource CostSource { get; }` | The source unlocks are paid from: the override when one is set, the stash that serves the unit, or its own bag and wallet. |
| `event Action<VtUnlockDefinition> OnUnlocked` | Fires after an unlock was bought or granted, for this unit or its stash. |
| `event Action<VtUnlockDefinition, VtUnlockFailureReason> OnUnlockFailed` | Fires when a `TryUnlock` call is refused, with the reason. |
| `void Initialize()` | Cache siblings. Idempotent; public for the late-attach path. |
| `void SetCostSource(IVtCostSource source)` | Pay for unlocks from `source` and keep them on this unit. Null goes back to the default choice. |
| `static bool IsUnlocked(VtUnit unit, VtUnlockDefinition unlock)` | Whether `unit` owns `unlock`: kept by the unit itself or by a shared stash whose scope includes it, wherever the unit stands. A null unlock is always owned, so a buildable without one is never locked. |
| `bool Has(VtUnlockDefinition unlock)` | Whether this unit owns `unlock`, itself or through its stash. |
| `bool CanUnlock(VtUnlockDefinition unlock, out VtUnlockFailureReason reason)` | Every check `TryUnlock` runs, without paying. Pure query. |
| `bool TryUnlock(VtUnlockDefinition unlock, out VtUnlockFailureReason reason)` | Buy `unlock`: pay its cost from `CostSource` and keep it with whoever paid. On a predicting client the request is forwarded and this returns false with `VtUnlockFailureReason.AuthorityNotLocal`. |
| `bool Grant(VtUnlockDefinition unlock)` | Give this unit `unlock` for free, such as a quest reward. Kept on the unit, not its stash; use `VtSharedStash.GrantUnlock` for the team. Authority-gated. |
| `void ApplyUnlocksFromNet(IReadOnlyList<VtUnlockDefinition> snapshot)` | Replace the unit's own unlocks with `snapshot`. Bypasses the authority gate: the replication and load path. Fires `OnUnlocked` for each one that is new. |

## VtUnlockDefinition

Asset. Create it with **Create → Vantage → Progression → Unlock**.

Something bought once and kept for good: a research step, a blueprint, a tier of the tech tree. A buildable or recipe that names it in `Required Unlock` is refused until it is bought.

### Inspector fields

#### General

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Id (`id`) | `string` | Empty |  | Stable string identifier for save files and network payloads. Convention: 'unlock.<area>.<name>'. |
| Display Name (`displayName`) | `string` | Empty |  | Name shown to the player. |
| Description (`description`) | `string` | Empty |  | Description shown in the tooltip. |
| Icon (`icon`) | `Sprite` | None |  | Icon for menus and tooltips. Optional. |
| Icon Id (`iconId`) | `string` | Empty |  | Name of an icon from the package's icon set (VtIcons), used when Icon is empty. Optional. |

#### Cost

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Currency Cost (`currencyCost`) | [VtCurrencyAmount](currency.md#vtcurrencyamount)[] | Empty |  | Currency paid once on unlock, such as build points or research points. |
| Item Cost (`itemCost`) | [VtRecipeIngredient](crafting.md#vtrecipeingredient)[] | Empty |  | Items paid once on unlock. |

#### Prerequisites

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Required Unlocks (`requiredUnlocks`) | [VtUnlockDefinition](#vtunlockdefinition)[] | Empty |  | Unlocks that must be owned first. |
| Required Level (`requiredLevel`) | `int` | 0 | ≥ 0 | Minimum level of the unit buying it. 0 = no gate. |

## Enums

### VtUnlockFailureReason

Why `VtUnitUnlocks.TryUnlock` was refused.

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `None` | Nothing went wrong. |
| `UnlockNull` | No unlock was given. |
| `AlreadyUnlocked` | It is already owned. |
| `MissingPrerequisite` | One of its required unlocks is not owned yet. |
| `LevelTooLow` | The unit's level is below the unlock's required level. |
| `MissingItems` | The cost source lacks the items. |
| `MissingCurrency` | The cost source lacks the currency. |
| `AuthorityNotLocal` | This process is not the authority; the request was forwarded. |
